name: Essential Hypertension
description: Primary hypertension with systolic BP consistently above 140mmHg. Patient reports occasional headaches and dizziness.
treatment: Amlodipine 5mg daily, low-sodium diet, regular blood pressure monitoring
notes: Patient advised on lifestyle modifications. Follow-up in 4 weeks.

name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
description: Type 2 diabetes without complications. HbA1c at 7.8%. Patient managing diet but requires medication.
treatment: Metformin 500mg twice daily, diabetic diet plan, monthly glucose monitoring
notes: Referred to dietitian. Foot examination performed - normal.

name: Multiple Sclerosis
description: Relapsing-remitting MS diagnosed following MRI findings and clinical presentation. Patient reports fatigue and intermittent limb weakness.
treatment: Interferon beta-1a injections, physiotherapy, fatigue management program
notes: MRI scheduled in 6 months. Referred to MS specialist nurse.

name: Coronary Artery Disease
description: Atherosclerotic heart disease without angina. ECG and stress test confirm coronary artery narrowing.
treatment: Aspirin 100mg daily, Atorvastatin 40mg nightly, cardiac rehabilitation programme
notes: Angiography recommended. Patient counselled on risk factors.

name: Primary Osteoarthritis of Hip
description: Unilateral hip osteoarthritis with progressive joint space narrowing seen on X-ray. Significant pain on weight-bearing.
treatment: Naproxen 500mg twice daily, physiotherapy, joint injection considered
notes: Surgical referral may be required if conservative treatment fails.

name: Acute Upper Respiratory Infection
description: Viral upper respiratory tract infection with sore throat, nasal congestion and mild fever (38.1°C).
treatment: Rest, increased fluids, Paracetamol 1g four times daily, nasal decongestant
notes: Antibiotics not indicated (viral cause suspected). Review if not improved in 7 days.
